newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: AEV forms new company for utility bid.
newsitem.headline: AEV forms new company for utility bid.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Venture (AEV) said on Friday it has formed a new company along with six other local and foreign firms to vie for the privatisation of the Philippine's largest water utility.

In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, AEV said the new company, to be called Philippine Water and Utilities Corp, will carry out the project should the consortium be awarded the privatisation of the Metropolitan Waterworks and Sewerage System (MWSS).
AEC will have a 30 percent stake in the company while Compagnie Generale des Eaux (CGE) will hold a 27 percent participating interest.
Other members of the consortium are Marubeni Corp, Dharmala Philippines Inc, local unlisted firm Sureste Realty Corp, Puncak Niaga Sdn Berhad of Malaysia and House of Investments Inc.
The bidding has been scheduled for the end of the year, with the final contracts to be awarded in January.
The AEV-led consortium is one of four groups that the MWSS has shortlisted.
